summary: Pawprint Habits ranks mid-pack for its highest-intent keyword and is leaking discovery to two competitors with stronger subtitles. The fastest unlock is a subtitle rewrite that pulls 'habit tracker' to the front; the keywords field has two low-value slots that should be reclaimed.

keywordDiagnosis.recommendation: Move 'habit tracker' from the keywords field into the subtitle — high intent, currently ranking below the fold.
Keep in the keywords field; pair with 'streaks' in the next screenshot caption to reinforce intent.

competitorTrail.name: Streakly
competitorTrail.notes: Outranks Pawprint Habits on both shared keywords. Subtitle leads with 'Habit Tracker', which Pawprint Habits buries.

competitorTrail.name: RoutineLab
competitorTrail.notes: Lower ratings volume but tighter keyword field — three high-intent terms, no filler.

title.notes: Strong brand recall, but doesn't carry a category keyword.

subtitle.notes: 'Daily Routine & Streaks' uses one medium-intent term — leaves the highest-intent keyword on the table.

keywords.notes: Two of ten slots spent on near-duplicates of words already in the subtitle.

screenshots.notes: Captions are readable and benefit-led; first frame buries the streak feature below the fold.

recommendations.action: Rewrite subtitle to lead with 'Habit Tracker'.
recommendations.rationale: Highest-intent keyword is currently in the keywords field where it competes for surface area. Moving it to the subtitle is a one-character-budget change.
Two slots duplicate words already in the title/subtitle and yield no additional rank coverage.

recommendations.action: Promote the streak feature to screenshot frame 1.
recommendations.rationale: Streakly's lead with streaks correlates with its higher conversion on shared keywords; first-frame promotion is the cheapest test.
